steps.text: From the home page, open the community you want to look at.
steps.title: Open your community

steps.text: The dashboard adapts to your role. As a member you do not see the community's management, but your own situation inside it.
steps.title: The dashboard

steps.text: The first tile totals, over the last thirty days, what you consumed and what the sharing brought you, then breaks it down meter by meter.
steps.title: My energy here

steps.text: For each sharing operation the tile shows the share that comes to you: a fixed percentage, a split in proportion to your consumption, or a note that your meter is not part of the key currently in force.
steps.title: My participation

steps.text: The tile confirms your record is active, or flags that it is still waiting for a manager to validate it.
steps.title: My member record

steps.text: Member count, regulator, website: enough to know who you are dealing with. The link opens the community's full information page.
steps.title: About this community

steps.text: These two tiles only appear when the community uses the matching modules. Your unpaid invoices are summarised there, as are the latest posts on the news board.
steps.title: Invoices and news

steps.text: The "Refresh" button reloads every tile without reloading the page.
steps.title: Refresh

steps.text: The tiles reload one by one and settle back with the freshest data.
steps.title: Up-to-date data
